bias.en: Bearish · MACD near a cross back up, testing the 10-day
bias.zh: 看空 · MACD 接近重新上穿，测试 10 日均线

read.en: Broadcom rose 3.1% on Nov 3 to $332.13, trading between $326.61 and $335.74. It is just below the rising 5-day ($335.5) and falling 10-day ($333.2), and below the falling 30-day ($346.0), 100-day ($369.7) and 200-day ($367.5). MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 2, below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross back up; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($351.09), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: 博通 11月3日上涨 3.1%，收于 $332.13，盘中区间 $326.61–335.74。股价略低于上行的 5 日（$335.5）和下行的 10 日均线（$333.2），并位于下行的 30 日（$346.0）、100 日（$369.7）和 200 日均线（$367.5）下方。MACD 于 11月2日下穿信号线，在零轴之下，柱状图收窄、接近重新上穿；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$351.09），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The $319.3–321 support held again; the high of $335.74 pushed through the $333.4–333.6 resistance but the close slipped back under the 10-day. Resistance is $333.2–335.7 (10 and 5-day, Nov 3 high), then $338.8–341.1 and $346–352.4 (30-day, SAR, Oct 28 high). Support is $326.6 (Nov 3 low), then $319.3–321 and $314.1–316.3. A close above $335.7 would target $339–341; below $326.6, $319–321.
